justifications.fit: the new test names describe the mechanism and the evidence fragment follows the repository template at docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-tests-behaviour/source-text-assertions-multi-site.html with no plan label in any symbol.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the ten scoped files drop from twenty-three source-text sites at 4e4de5ba to six at 35d93267a (tests/test_fleet_counter_coverage.py and tests/test_crew_monitor_output.py), the delivered section-5 behaviour, but two deleted absence-guards fall in section 5's keep carve-out and only one of the three negative controls the done-when asks for was logged.
justifications.reuse: the rewritten tests extend the shared owners rather than forking them (a spy on reckon/crew/runs.py proves both callers reach one composition) and every deleted test cites an existing behaviour test rather than a new copy.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the nine changed paths is inside the ten-file scope and the declared evidence-fragment path, and no plan or index state was touched.
